# Peel UI Registry Reference

This reference lists the registry components, their implemented behavior, public props, and install commands.

## Repository Versions

The repository package manifest specifies React 19.2.8, React DOM 19.2.8, Next.js 16.3.6, and Tailwind CSS ^4. These are the versions declared by this repository, not a compatibility statement for other versions.

## Global Design Tokens

The following CSS custom properties are defined in `src/app/globals.css`:

| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--peel-base` | `#08090a` |
| `--peel-surface` | `#12141a` |
| `--peel-surface-raised` | `#181b22` |
| `--peel-surface-active` | `#1e2129` |
| `--peel-border` | `#232730` |
| `--peel-border-subtle` | `#1a1d24` |
| `--peel-border-focus` | `#f5f5f7` |
| `--peel-text-primary` | `#f5f5f7` |
| `--peel-text-secondary` | `#8a8f98` |
| `--peel-text-tertiary` | `#51555e` |
| `--peel-text-mono` | `#9ea3ad` |
| `--peel-lime` | `#84ff00` |
| `--peel-lime-foreground` | `#08090a` |
| `--peel-lime-muted` | `rgba(132, 255, 0, 0.10)` |
| `--peel-coral` | `#ff553e` |
| `--peel-coral-foreground` | `#ffffff` |
| `--peel-coral-muted` | `rgba(255, 85, 62, 0.10)` |
| `--peel-success` | `#34d399` |
| `--peel-danger` | `#ff453a` |

## Registry Components

### 1. Save State Pill (`save-state-pill`)

Source: `src/components/ui/save-state-pill.tsx`.

Displays idle, saving, saved, failed, offline, and conflict states. Its props are `state`, `lastSavedAt`, `onRetry`, `onReviewConflict`, `className`, and `interactiveDemo`. The `state` values are `"idle"`, `"saving"`, `"saved"`, `"failed"`, `"offline"`, and `"conflict"`.

Dependencies: `motion`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/save-state-pill.json
```

### 2. Slide to Confirm (`slide-to-confirm`)

Source: `src/components/ui/slide-to-confirm.tsx`.

Calls `onConfirm` when the drag reaches 75% of the track; a drag released below that threshold returns to the starting position. Props: `label`, `confirmedLabel`, `onConfirm`, `onReset`, `autoResetTimeout`, `className`, and `disabled`.

Dependencies: `motion`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/slide-to-confirm.json
```

### 3. Magnetic Split Button (`magnetic-split-button`)

Source: `src/components/ui/magnetic-split-button.tsx`.

Renders a primary action and a menu of selectable actions. Props: `defaultAction`, `actions`, `onAction`, and `className`. Each action has an `id`, a `label`, and an optional `icon`; `onAction` receives the selected action label.

Dependencies: `motion`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/magnetic-split-button.json
```

### 4. Tactile OTP Input (`tactile-otp-input`)

Source: `src/components/ui/tactile-otp-input.tsx`.

Accepts numeric input in configurable digit slots and calls `onComplete` when all slots are filled. Props: `length`, `initialValues`, `onComplete`, and `className`.

Dependencies: `motion`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/tactile-otp-input.json
```

The registry item name is `tactile-otp-input` and its title is `Tactile OTP Input`.

### 5. Privacy Shutter (`privacy-shutter`)

Source: `src/components/ui/privacy-shutter.tsx`.

Uses a draggable shutter to reveal or conceal an API key; crossing 80% of the drag range locks it open. Props: `apiKey`, `maskedKey`, `label`, `onCopy`, `onToggleLock`, and `className`.

Dependencies: `motion`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/privacy-shutter.json
```

### 6. Voice Pill (`voice-pill`)

Source: `src/components/ui/voice-pill.tsx`.

Uses microphone audio or a simulated signal, and can display its waveform on a canvas or allow slide-to-cancel. In addition to native button props, `VoicePillProps` includes `accentColor`, `stopColor`, `iconColor`, `background`, `borderColor`, `size`, `shape`, `reach`, `showTime`, `waveform`, `slideToCancel`, `cancelDistance`, `attack`, `release`, `sensitivity`, `floor`, `openDuration`, `pressScale`, `mode`, `holdAfter`, `reactive`, `disabled`, `ariaLabel`, `onStart`, `onStop`, and `className`.

Dependency: `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/voice-pill.json
```

### 7. Tactile Filter Chips (`filter-chips`)

Source: `src/components/ui/filter-chips.tsx`.

Provides single- or multiple-selection chips with optional counts, disabled options, and a clear action. Props: `options`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `mode`, `size`, `showClear`, and `className`. Each option has an `id` and `label`, with optional `count`, `icon`, and `disabled`.

Dependency: `motion`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/filter-chips.json
```

### 8. Note Button (`note-button`)

Source files: `src/components/ui/note-button/index.ts`, `note-root.tsx`, `note-trigger.tsx`, `note-panel.tsx`, and `line-gutter.tsx`.

Exports `NoteRoot`, `NoteTrigger`, `NotePanel`, and the compound `Note` object. `NoteRootProps` includes `children`, `storageKey`, `open`, `onOpenChange`, `defaultOpen`, `value`, `onValueChange`, `placement`, `width`, `height`, `breakpoint`, and `showLineNumbers`. `NoteTrigger` accepts native button props and an optional `onClick`; `NotePanel` takes no props. Note text is persisted using `localStorage` when the value is uncontrolled.

Dependencies: `gsap`, `@gsap/react`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/note-button.json
```

### 9. Skeleton Handoff (`skeleton-handoff`)

Source: `src/components/ui/skeleton-handoff.tsx`.

Matches skeleton blocks and content by ID and animates matching blocks into their targets. It supports loading, ready, and error states, and uses a 150 millisecond `skipBelow` default. `Handoff` props: `status`, `skeleton`, `children`, `duration`, `stagger`, `skipBelow`, `loadingLabel`, `readyLabel`, `errorLabel`, `onHandoffStart`, `onHandoffComplete`, and `className`. `HandoffBlock` props: `id`, `className`, and `as`. `HandoffTarget` has those props plus `children`.

Dependencies: `gsap`, `@gsap/react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/skeleton-handoff.json
```

### 10. Moiré Field (`moire-field`)

Source: `src/components/ui/moire-field.tsx`.

Full-bleed background with dual gratings, calm falloff masks, and pointer response. Props: `variant`, `pitch` (clamp 6 to 32, default 9), `thickness` (clamp 0 to 1, default 0.5), `angle`, `drift`, `interactive`, `calm`, `calmAmount`, `colorA`, `colorB`, `background`, `paused`, `className`, and `children`.

Dependencies: none.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/moire-field.json
```

### 11. Moiré Intro (`moire-intro`)

Source: `src/components/ui/moire-intro.tsx`.

Progress-driven full-screen intro where dual line gratings calm into register before a mechanical settle and alternating slat reveal. Props: `open`, `progress`, `duration`, `onComplete`, `label`, `position`, `lockScroll`, `pitch`, `thickness`, `angle`, `colorA`, `colorB`, `background`, and `className`.

Dependencies: `gsap`, `@gsap/react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/moire-intro.json
```

### 12. Waitlist Join (`waitlist-join`)

Source: `src/components/ui/waitlist-join.tsx`.

An email input with live social proof that morphs into a personal confirmation card on submit. Shows waitlist position, avatars, invite link copying, and an accessible layout morph. Props: `onSubmit`, `count`, `avatars`, `inviteUrl`, `placeholder`, `buttonLabel`, and `className`.

Dependencies: `motion`, `lucide-react`.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://peel-ui.vercel.app/r/waitlist-join.json
```
